name: Kono Koi☆Megane!
source:
One day the protagonist drops her glasses into a pond.
Then a goddess appeared and said "Were the glasses you dropped gold? Or were they silver?"
The protagonist responds "They were normal glasses."
The goddess smiled wryly and replied "You're quite honest, as a reward I shall give you these {cursed glasses}."
"I don't need those!!"
But despite the refusal the goddess forcefully put them on the protagonist.
"If the person who wears those glasses doesn't find their fated lover within one week then they will be cursed to turn into a pair of glasses."
"Cursed!? H-hey wait!"
But the goddess ignores the shouts and sinks back into the lake while smiling.

Having been given the {Cursed Glasses} will the protagonist find their fated lover? Or will they spend the rest of their life as a pair of glasses?

LOVE　　or　　MEGANE?
translation:
一天，主角把眼鏡掉進了池塘。
這時，一位女神出現了，問道：「你掉的是金眼鏡，還是銀眼鏡？」
主角回答：「只是普通的眼鏡。」
女神苦笑著說：「你很誠實。作為獎勵，我就把這副『詛咒眼鏡』送給你。」
「我才不要！！」
然而，女神不顧她的拒絕，硬是把眼鏡給她戴上了。
「戴上這副眼鏡的人，如果沒能在一週內找到命中註定的戀人，就會受到詛咒，變成一副眼鏡。」
「詛咒！？等、等等！」
女神卻無視她的喊聲，微笑著沉回了湖裡。

被迫戴上「詛咒眼鏡」的主角，能找到命中註定的戀人嗎？還是說，她將作為一副眼鏡度過餘生？

戀愛，還是眼鏡？
